rationale: The actual source does not implement the frozen proposal: model.RQVAE.forward computes L_tr as -(r * soft_target).sum(...), not the specified negative log of sum_k(r*s); its objective also totals only rec + assign + batch-zero balance + transition, not the stated full objective semantics. More decisively, the hard assignment is not exact: poincare_residual.py uses auction plus single-item/two-item repairs, not exact min-cost transport or lexicographic tie resolution (the trainer comments acknowledge this). The math suite tests geometry against independent formulas, but Sinkhorn and assignment tests chiefly check implementation constants/properties, not the frozen transport and exact optimal labels against an independent oracle. DDP uses real ranks/model and entrypoint invokes trainer.main; these do not cure the substantive mechanism mismatch.
